contexts.text: To cleave all their shoulder () = to deprive of all power, so that they know nothing.
He clave the wood of the burnt-offering () = the merit of righteousness... To cleave wood = to place merit in the goods which are of works... Such appear to saw and cleave wood. TCR 441:end.
The clefts of the rocks () = the truths of faith in obscurity, because removed from the light of Heaven.
I will set thee in a cleft of the rock () = what is obscure and false of faith, such as prevails with those who are in externals without an internal. AC 10582:4, Illustrated. (See Hole.)
Such there dwell in caves, or in fissures.
The Hells... are open only through holes and clefts as of rocks... HH 584.
Their entrances appear like holes in the earth, and like fissures in the mountains... Hence it is that holes and clefts = falsities of evil... Illustrated.
Hence it is evident what is signified by caves, holes, clefts, and chinks. Illustrated.

To go into the caves of the rocks, and into the clefts of the rocks () = the damnation of those who are in evils and falsities from the loves of self and of the world, and from the pride of their Own intelligence; for their Hells appear like caves in the rocks, and the approaches to them like clefts of the rocks.
The clefts of the rocks () = where is the faith of falsity.
